headline: Approved minutes, motor vehicle excise tax abatements, and statutory exemption applications under Clauses 17E, 22, 22D, 22E, 37A, and 41C.
summary: The Board of Assessors approved minutes from the August 18, 2026 meeting and approved motor vehicle excise abatements by signature for two weeks in August with no denials. The board also approved statutory exemption applications under Clauses 17E, 22, 22D, 22E, 37A, and 41C. The FY27 Certification review is complete and awaiting a preliminary value from the State BLA, targeted for completion by 09/14.
decisions: Approved the minutes from the August 18, 2026 meeting.
Approved motor vehicle excise tax abatements for the week of August 10 to August 14 by signatures.
Approved motor vehicle excise tax abatements for the week of August 17 to August 21 by signatures.

Approved statutory exemption applications under Clause 17E (5 applications), Clause 22 (3 applications), Clause 22D (1 application), Clause 22E (4 applications), Clause 37A (2 applications), and Clause 41C (6 applications).

MINUTES  
  
THE MEETING OF THE BOARD OF ASSESSORS   
LOWELL MA September 10, 2026
  
A meeting of the Board of Assessors took place on September 01, 2026, at 9:30 AM in Room 36 
at Lowell City Hall:  
In attendance: Chief Assessor; E. Brideau, Deputy Chief Assessor; R. Rondeau, Assessor; A. 
Lombardo
R. Rondeau called to order the meeting at 9:30 AM and went into a recess
R. Rondeau resumed the meeting at 11:05 AM
1. Review of minutes from August 18, 2026 meetings – R. Rondeau made a motion to 
approve the minutes, A. Lombardo 2nd – Unanimous.
2. Applications for MOTOR VEHICLE EXCISE TAX ABATEMENTS (supporting         
 documentation attached to each application)  
  Motor Vehicle Excise Abatements
o Week of August 10 to August 14 – Approved by signatures
o Week of August 17 to August 21 – Approved by signatures
o MVE Abatements for denial – None
3. Statutory Exemptions – Clause 17E: 5 applications, Clause 22: 3 applications, 22D: 1 
application, Clause 22E: 4 applications, Clause 37A: 2 applications, and Clause 41C: 6 
applications – A. Lombardo made a motion to approve these applications, R. Rondeau 2nd – 
Unanimous.
4. FY27 Certification – our field advisor has completed the review, it is currently with the 
State BLA and waiting for the preliminary value. The goal is to have it completed by 09/14.
5. New Business – None
6. Old Business – None
Motion to adjourn at 11:09 AM R. Rondeau, A. Lombardo 2nd – Unanimous.
Respectfully submitted,
Chornai Pech
Administrative Assistant
